rationale: Strong product-market fit signals with 300 paying customers and 18% MoM MRR growth. However, the GTM motion (inbound + accountant partnerships) isn't quantified by channel, so it's unclear how repeatable this is beyond the founders.
conviction_points: 300 paying customers with 112% NDR — customers are expanding usage
Founding team has domain expertise (ex-Intuit, ex-Stripe)
key_concerns: GTM motion is described but not proven — no channel-level economics
Unclear if the accountant-partnership channel is repeatable beyond the founders' existing relationships
No churn analysis shared — need cohort data
questions_for_founders: Walk me through your last 5 customer wins — how did you find them and what closed the deal?
What's your CAC by channel (inbound vs. accountant partnerships)?
diligence_requirements: Cohort retention curves (monthly, by acquisition channel)
